text_block_list.text:
A few months have passed since
I became Espoir City's trainer.

Today, my training with her
began once more, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
――1600 meters, winner takes all.
Got it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm gonna chase you down and win!
Don't you go cryin' when you lose, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Shakur! Catch me if you can!
I'll show ya how a real front-runner rolls!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Don't even need to look.
I figured out your stats ages ago.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"An Oka Sho Umamusume, a Derby Umamusume...
GⅠ Umamusume... and a Grand Prix Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"......I'm gonna......!
Just like that... so I won't lose, either......!!"
choice_data_list: Espo!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoa-ooh?! What's that?!

"...And so, Espoir City's
'wandering eye' habit was pretty terrible."
And furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Start easy at 18-18"?
One furlong in 18 seconds...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Without pushing too hard...
............Without pushing too hard...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I am SO not pushing myself, okayyy?!
choice_data_list: Wait, Espoooo...!?

text_block_list.text:
"Even when listening to a conversation like this,
some get hung up on 'a single word'
and lose sight of the big picture."
...In other words, she simply cannot maintain the concentration necessary for training. She is constantly distracted by trivial remarks and her surroundings...
choice_data_list: (I have to do something about this problem...!)

text_block_list.text:
I quickly wrote into my textbook.
"Required: First, improve concentration."
And the solution that flashed into my mind was---

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Haaah? Zazen meditation?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaah? Yoga?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Fuuu... Huuuuuumph...?
An escape room hereee...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
F-F-F-Fine by meee!?
I'll solve the mystery before you do!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ......I-I'm not scared at aaaaaall!

"...And so, for the past week, I've tried
every possible way to boost concentration."

Zazen, yoga, an escape room to train the brain...
Taking her to all those places left my wallet
depressingly empty, though.
choice_data_list: (But, maybe this will make it work somehow!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Let's run! Here we go!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...It's totally fine, right?!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Run your heart out, Espo!!
Yeah! Go give it a run, Espo!!

text_block_list.text:
I send her off and pray. ...Just one thing.
If even a single positive effect takes place—we win!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Raaaaaaaah!!
choice_data_list: (How was that, Espo...!?)
(How'd it go, Espo...!?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: No! I'm getting distracted again!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... phew...!
Well, how about that...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't the guys in the stands
think I was way stronger than the rest, too...?
choice_data_list: O-Ohh... Next time, look at the stands too...
I-I see... Next time, look at the stands too...

text_block_list.text: ...None of the methods I prepared worked.

I'm reminded once again.
Dealing with her is exceedingly difficult.
That's precisely why it's in the textbook—
choice_data_list: (I'll write down each countermeasure one by one)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Hah! Trainer,
you're reading that 'textbook' again?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What's it say next?
Work on my speed even more, huh?
choice_data_list: Ahaha, I wonder what it says...

text_block_list.text:
After finishing training with Espoir City,
we trudged our way back.

Weeks have quickly passed without being able to train as planned.
There are only a few days left until the Make Debut.

If adjustments seem difficult to make at this rate,
maybe we could postpone her debut race
to another date. If so—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Y-You bastard...! You want me to turn tail and run without even putting up a fight...!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you shitting meeeeee?!
Trainer contract, terminated! Terminate it right now!!"
choice_data_list: (Yeah, knew she'd say that. Let's scrap the postponement idea.)
(Yeah, she'd totally say that. Better not bring up postponing it.)

text_block_list.text:
She is a ball of pure defiance.
If something rubs her the wrong way, she rejects it to the bitter end.

Changing the schedule for the debut race would be difficult.
In that case—
choice_data_list: It's my job to get her into perfect condition.
It's my job to get her into perfect condition.

text_block_list.text: And so, just as I was rethinking my plans for the race... footsteps could be heard.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Heading home, you bastard?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I can still keep runnin', though!
I'm gonna do a quick lap around the perimeter!"
choice_data_list: Are you... doing voluntary training? Keep it up.
Doing some independent training, are you? Keep it up.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Shut up.
Looking at her back as she mutters a quiet curse, I realize something. She is by no means an insincere Umamusume.
She's an Umamusume who can put in the hard work for her races. However...
Vrrrrr... gh!!

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof! Woof-woof-woof!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
W-What's your problem, huh?!
Why you little... HEY!!

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner
text_block_list.text:
Pero-chan! Stop that, don't bark at strangers!
No barking! Bad boy!!
choice_data_list: Uh, um... what is going on here—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Urk... uuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't bark at me! Quiet down!
I'm tough, ya hear?! A punk like you is—

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof! W-W-Woof!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Woof!?

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner
text_block_list.text: Hey, Pero-chan!!
choice_data_list: Yees! Coming in!!

text_block_list.text:
Stepping between the menacing dog and
Espoir City, who was facing it trembling,
I separated the beast and the girl.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-I wasn't scared at all!
Not one bit, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —I'm heading home!
choice_data_list: Huh...? But you just said we were going to run the outer lap—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I... I'm on it! It's not like I forgot or anything, okay?!

Distracted by every single stimulus, she lost sight of her original purpose altogether.
...I feel a headache coming on.

Only a few weeks remain
until Espoir City's debut race.

"So that I can figure out a countermeasure
for her lack of focus before then...
I just have to... do everything I can!!"
